run_finetuning: run the finetuning loop to train a retriever model with in-batch negatives on a dataset
run_main: run the main entry point to parse options, load a retriever, and start finetuning
evaluate_model: evaluate a single encoder model by computing retrieval accuracy against positive and negative passages
evaluate_biencoder: evaluate a bi-encoder model with separate query and passage encoders using in-batch negatives
setup_distributed_training: setup distributed data parallel training with SAM/ASAM optimizers and knowledge distillation support
